Nickel-based superalloys are a type of alloy formed by adding various alloying elements (such as Fe, Cr, W, Co, Al, and Mo) to nickel as a matrix, and strengthening through solid solution strengthening, precipitation strengthening, or oxide dispersion strengthening (ODS) mechanisms.
